text:
Alex (PM): Quick sync — need a tight, customer-facing cut for Optimize Toolkit v1. Goal: ship non-destructive recommendations for batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization guidance + clear acceptance criteria. Vote by EOD.

Priya (Eng): Thumbs up. Proposal: MUST = simulator for batching, per-route cache toggle + metrics, read-only quant recs API. NICE = auto-rollout, eval-triggered ticketing, cost tradeoff slider.

Sam (ML): For quant recs, do a rules-based engine first. No auto-apply. Provide rationale + confidence for each rec. We'll include model-family rules + seq-length heuristics.

Noah (SRE): Must include safety controls: per-route circuit-breaker that disables prefix cache when latency or errors spike. Also we need a minimal runbook entry for oncall.

Maya (Prod Ops): Customers asked for an "explain" string and expected impact: expected latency delta, expected cost delta. Include in every rec response for audit.

Ivy (Data): I'll assemble a 3-domain prompt set to evaluate regressions and a thresholds spreadsheet. Suggest triggers: accuracy drop >=3% on control set OR latency p95 up >30% post-change.

Alex (PM): Acceptance criteria (MUST):
- Batching simulator that ingests sampled traffic and outputs recommended batch size, estimated p50/p95, and tradeoff table.
- Prefix/KV cache: per-route enable/disable, metrics (hit/miss, latency impact), and an ops circuit-breaker.
- Quantization recommendations API (read-only): returns [{model_family, quant_profile, rationale, confidence, expected_cost_delta}].
- Docs + 3 cookbooks: realtime chat, document-embedding service, and reranker.

Priya (Eng): Rough dev estimates: batching sim + API ~ 2.5w, cache toggles + CB ~1.5w, recs API ~1.5w, docs ~0.5w. With 3 Engs parallel -> ~3w.

Sam (ML): Initial rule examples:
- if seq_len_p50 < 64 and model in (llama2, mosaic): recommend 4-bit qprofile (rationale: minimal eval loss, large memory savings).
- if seq_len_p95 > 256: recommend enabling prefix cache and larger KV cache size.
- if route p95 > sla at batch_size 16 -> lower batch or prefer fp16.

Noah (SRE): Circuit-breaker heuristic: monitor 1m windows; if p95 latency increases by >=25% AND error rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive windows -> flip cache off and alert #eng-oncall + product. Deploy-bot should log the flip.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging: circuit-breaker prototype pushed. CI green.

Maya (Prod Ops): OPS acceptance: every rec must include: why, confidence(0-1), est_latency_delta_ms, est_cost_delta_pct. Customer wording: "Non-destructive recommendations with audit trail and safe fallbacks."

Ivy (Data): I'll produce dashboards showing before/after sim scenarios for one pilot tenant. Also will provide threshold csv.

Alex (PM): Action items + owners:
- Priya: RFC + API contract + sim design (due Tue).
- Sam: rulebook + sample evals + confidence model (due Wed).
- Ivy: prompt sets + thresholds + dashboard proto (due Wed).
- Noah: circuit-breaker runbook stub + metrics to emit (due Wed).
- Maya: docs template + audit text examples (due Thu).

Priya (Eng): Example API sketch to include in RFC:
```
POST /v1/optimize/recommend
{ "model": "mosaic-13b", "traffic": {"seq_len_p50": 48, "seq_len_p95": 190}, "sla": {"p95_ms": 500} }
--->
{ "recommendations": [ {"type":"quant","profile":"4bit-q0","confidence":"0.82","rationale":"short median seq_len; preserves eval metrics","est_latency_delta_ms":"-20","est_cost_delta_pct":"-40"}, {"type":"cache","action":"enable_prefix","confidence":"0.7","rationale":"long tail seq -> reduces KV ops","est_latency_delta_ms":"-35","est_cost_delta_pct":"+2"} ] }
```

Sam (ML): Add numeric confidence and include a small A/B harness for quality measurement when quant is applied. 2w effort for the harness.

Noah (SRE): We'll add an alert annotation to the circuit-breaker action and include a quick follow-up job to re-evaluate cache after 10m.

Alex (PM): Prioritization: if no objections by EOD, we'll commit MUST into the milestone and start discovery next Mon. Please react.

Priya (Eng): :thumbsup:

Sam (ML): :thumbsup:

Noah (SRE): :thumbsup:

Maya (Prod Ops): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: RFC created: rfc/optimize-recs-mvp-2976543210, assigned: Priya.

Alex (PM): Thanks team — conservative automation in v1, strong explainability, safe fallbacks. I'll file the milestone and calendar invites.
